say:1:1120609001:0.text: This manuscript... Where did you find it?
say:1:1120609001:0.source_cn: 这手稿……你们是在哪里找到的？

say:3:1120609002:0.text: We found it on the bandits we defeated just now. Chippy wonders what's written there...
say:3:1120609002:0.source_cn: 就在刚才被我们打倒的盗匪身上。这手稿上写的是什么啊……

say:5:1120609003:0.text: I can't read it either. Most of it has been blurred out, and the only legible parts are all scrambled up! Almost like a code...
say:5:1120609003:0.source_cn: 漫漫也读不懂。很多字都模糊不清，能看清楚的那些还被刻意...

say:6:1120609004:1.text: Wait a minute! This handwriting and the way it's encrypted... No way... Evan, come look at this!
say:6:1120609004:1.source_cn: 这字迹和加密方式……这该不会是……艾文，你快来看看！

say:9:1120609005:0.text: What?! But how could this be?!

say:10:1120609006:0.text: What's the matter? Is something wrong with the manuscript?
say:10:1120609006:0.source_cn: 嗯？你们在说什么？这张手稿有什么不对吗？

say:11:1120609007:0.text: We were just saying that this handwriting... It looks just like our father's!
say:11:1120609007:0.source_cn: 我们是说，这字迹……像是我们父亲的！

say:14:1120609008:0.text: Are you sure it's not just a coincidence?

say:15:1120609009:0.text: Our father was also a treasure hunter. His last adventure led him to the Eroded Enclave, and we haven't heard from him ever since...
say:15:1120609009:0.source_cn: 我们的父亲也是名宝藏猎人，他最后一次寻宝就是来风蚀飞地...

say:16:1120609010:0.text: Our neighbors kept saying that he abandoned us, but Oldiler and I never believed it for one second! Our father's not that kind of person!
say:16:1120609010:0.source_cn: 邻居总会悄悄地议论，说父亲抛弃了我们。欧迪尔和我都不相...

say:17:1120609011:1.text: The truth is I've never cared much for this profession because of my father, but I don't know what else to do with myself.
say:17:1120609011:1.source_cn: ……因为父亲的关系，我并不喜欢做这一行，可我也不知道自...

say:18:1120609012:1.text: I, on the other hand, think being a treasure hunter is great! It pays well sometimes, and it might even lead us to our father someday!
say:18:1120609012:1.source_cn: 我倒是觉得当个宝藏猎人挺不错的，能发财，说不定还能找到...

choice_prompt:19:1120609012.text: I, on the other hand, think being a treasure hunter is great! It pays well sometimes, and it might even lead us to our father someday!
choice_prompt:19:1120609012.source_cn: 我倒是觉得当个宝藏猎人挺不错的，能发财，说不定还能找到父亲的踪迹。

say:20:1120609013:1.text: You're right. This might be our best shot at finding our father... At the very least, it means he's been through here before.
say:20:1120609013:1.source_cn: 的确，这份手稿或许是我们找到父亲的契机……这说明他一定...

say:21:1120609014:1.text: But so much of the writing has been blurred away...
say:21:1120609014:1.source_cn: 可手稿上面的字已经模糊不清了……

say:22:1120609015:0.text: I know a recipe for a magic detergent that might clear things up for us!
say:22:1120609015:0.source_cn: 漫漫知道一种魔法清洁剂，或许有用！

say:25:1120609016:1.text: But we're in the middle of the desert! Where are we supposed to find the materials to make it?
say:25:1120609016:1.source_cn: 可是，这里是荒漠，到哪里去找制作魔法清洁剂的材料？

say:26:1120609017:1.text: Don't worry. The pit of a <style="highlight">sandstone nut</style> can be extracted and used as a substitute for making the magic detergent.

say:27:1120609018:1.text: Really?! And here Chippy thought sandstone nuts were only good for snacking.
say:27:1120609018:1.source_cn: 什么？！满满还以为荒漠盐津仁只能当零食吃呢！

choice:19:1:2.text: You might be able to find him if you crack the code.
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 或许破解手稿就能找到他
choice:19:1:2.male: You might be able to find him if you crack the code.
choice:19:1:2.female: You might be able to find him if you crack the code.
